info.name: Archive 81 - Universi alternativi
info.plot: Archive 81 – Universi alternativi ci porta nella vita di Dan Turner che nella vita lavora come archivista in un museo, specializzato nel recuperare e restaurare vecchie cassette. Un giorno viene contattato da un misterioso imprenditore che gli assegna l’incarico di restaurare delle cassette di un documentario amatoriale di una studentessa, rimaste danneggiate nel 1994 a seguito di un incendio. Nello stesso anno in cui anche Dan ha perso tutta la sua famiglia in un incendio...

episodes.name: Mystery Signals
episodes.plot: Haunted by a family tragedy, Dan begins to restore videotapes for a cryptic firm. Then he's startled to learn of his connection to their missing creator.

translations.value: Haunted by a family tragedy, Dan begins to restore videotapes for a cryptic firm. Then he's startled to learn of his connection to their missing creator.

episodes.name: Wellspring
episodes.plot: Messages from the dead arrive while Dan follows Melody on her investigation into the Visser. But who's watching the watcher — and what lies below?

translations.value: Messages from the dead arrive while Dan follows Melody on her investigation into the Visser. But who's watching the watcher — and what lies below?

episodes.name: Terror in the Aisles
episodes.plot: The past loops back around as Melody returns to Steven with Jess. Mark checks out a find. Dan tries to map his situation, but he may be losing his way.

translations.value: The past loops back around as Melody returns to Steven with Jess. Mark checks out a find. Dan tries to map his situation, but he may be losing his way.

episodes.name: Spirit Receivers
episodes.plot: In the woods, Dan encounters the unexpected. In the tapes, Melody learns about the cult and makes contact during a shocking séance.

translations.value: In the woods, Dan encounters the unexpected. In the tapes, Melody learns about the cult and makes contact during a shocking séance.

episodes.name: Through the Looking Glass
episodes.plot: The past blurs into the present when Melody visits a forbidden floor in search of an inspired Anabelle. Music leads to lost souls — and revelations.

translations.value: The past blurs into the present when Melody visits a forbidden floor in search of an inspired Anabelle. Music leads to lost souls — and revelations.

episodes.name: The Circle
episodes.plot: A circle tightens, panic grows: Dan learns about his predecessor, and Melody tries to track the source of the Visser's dangers. Yet the evil spreads.

translations.value: A circle tightens, panic grows: Dan learns about his predecessor, and Melody tries to track the source of the Visser's dangers. Yet the evil spreads.

episodes.name: The Ferryman
episodes.plot: The veil drops from a cursed film's origins. At the Vos Mansion in 1924, Iris recruits Rose for a blood ritual. Dan knows he must find Anabelle.

translations.value: The veil drops from a cursed film's origins. At the Vos Mansion in 1924, Iris recruits Rose for a blood ritual. Dan knows he must find Anabelle.

episodes.name: What Lies Beneath
episodes.plot: The Otherworld beckons. Melody circles back to the Visser, where a new device captures a sacrifice. So much depends on Dan's journey into the unknown.

translations.value: The Otherworld beckons. Melody circles back to the Visser, where a new device captures a sacrifice. So much depends on Dan's journey into the unknown.
